title: Pure Cyberse
summary: Pure Cyberse multi-summon toolkit centered on Yusaku Fujiki's 'Cyberse' named lineup, combining Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz mechanics with generic Cyberse staples. Led by Cyberse Witch and Cyberse Wicckid, the deck searches across summon types to assemble Cyberse Magician, Cyberse Quantum Dragon, and Cyberse Clock Dragon for an impenetrable attack and targeting lock.

summary.title: Starters
points: Lady Debug on Normal or Special Summon searches any Level 3 or lower Cyberse monster from your Deck, fetching Cyberse Synchron, Cyberse Converter, or Backup Secretary.
Cyberse Gadget on Normal Summon revives a Level 2 or lower monster from your GY and generates a Cyberse Gadget Token when sent from field to GY.
Clock Wyvern spawns a Clock Token on summon, immediately enabling Link-2 climbs into Cyberse Witch or Cyberse Wicckid, and acts as the named material for Cyberse Clock Dragon.
Cynet Mining sends 1 card from hand to GY to search any Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Lady Debug + Cynet Mining
steps: Normal Summon Lady Debug and search Backup Secretary from your Deck.
Special Summon Backup Secretary from hand, then Link Summon Cyberse Witch using Lady Debug and Backup Secretary.
Activate Cynet Mining, sending a card to GY to search Cyberse Synchron; summon a monster to Cyberse Witch's arrow to activate Witch.
Banish a Spell from GY with Cyberse Witch to add both Cyberse Magician and Cynet Ritual from Deck to hand, then revive Cyberse Synchron from your GY.
Activate Cynet Ritual, tributing Cyberse monsters to Ritual Summon Cyberse Magician.
Use Cyberse Synchron to double a monster's Level and Synchro Summon Cyberse Quantum Dragon, establishing the Magician-Quantum lock.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Cyberse Magician halves all damage you take; while you control a Link Monster, the opponent cannot target any other monster for attacks or card effects.

Cyberse Quantum Dragon bounces any monster it battles back to the hand at the start of the Damage Step; while you control a Link Monster, the opponent cannot attack or target other monsters, creating a complete mutual lock alongside Cyberse Magician.

Cyberse Clock Dragon sends cards from the top of the Deck to the GY equal to the Link Ratings of its materials, gaining 1000 ATK for each card sent and preventing opponent targeting while you control a Link Monster.

Firewall Dragon Singularity is a Link-6 titan that bounces cards from the opponent's field or GY as a Quick Effect up to the number of Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz monsters you control or have in the GY.
Decode Talker Heatsoul pays 1000 LP on either player's turn to draw 1 card, refueling your hand continuously.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Cynet Ritual summons Cyberse Magician and banishes itself from the GY while you control no monsters to Special Summon two Cynet Tokens.
Cynet Fusion uses materials from hand or field, and can even fuse using Link Monsters from your GY if you control no monsters in the Extra Monster Zone.

Cynet Conflict is a Counter Trap that negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect activation while you control a Code Talker monster, banishing the negated card and preventing the opponent from activating cards with that name.
Cynet Optimization grants an extra Normal Summon of a Cyberse monster and protects your attacking Cyberse monsters from opponent activations.
